profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Panic Button
profile.summary:
When my current employer, Panic Button, no longer needs me, I plan on retiring.  I have no desire to start over again at another company.

Creative Software Engineer specializing in programming efficiency.  Extensive experience writing performance analysis tools and operating systems, using both C and assembly language. IBM Master Inventor with 30 issued patents and more pending.  Test automaton experience working on Star Wars: The Old Republic at BioWare and Torchlight II at Panic Button.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing tools for console game developers.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed multi-player support for Disney's Infinity on the WiiU platform.

positions.title: Freelance Contractor
positions.description: Develop and support GUI applications using Java Swing for internal use by QuestTech and its clients.

positions.title: QA Programmer
positions.description: Test automation for "Star Wars: The Old Republic" at the BioWare studios in Austin, TX. The Job included creating an automated player that could join human players to test group content.
